content: पारिषद {%a.%} (-दी|{%f.%}) Belonging to an assembly or council. .{@-दः@} .²1 A person present at an assembly, a member of an assembly, such as an assessor. .²2 A kingʼs companion. .{@-दाः@} {%m.%} (<ab>pl.</ab>) The retinue of a god; तिथिष्विव महादेवो वृतः पारिषदां गणैः <ls>Rām. 3. 25. 12</ls>. .{@-दम्@} Taking part in an assembly.
